name: Scroll of And They Spoke of Fire

system.description: Your outstretched hand vomits a 15' cone of flame, and screams come with it.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and creatures in the cone take d4 persistent fire damage.
outcomes.success: Every creature in the cone takes d8 damage.
outcomes.ruin: The screams are yours: you take d4 damage and are Deafened until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
